tasks.description: Design spec: vector-aware context memory retrieval contracts with qmd/pvector adapter interface, fallback strategy, and bounded retrieval budgets
Design spec: enhanced expertise foundation — routing signals schema, confidence scoring model, governed learning loop lifecycle, explainability surface
Design spec: WebUI console data models for run/session management and tasks/mission tracking, API surface definition
Implement qmd/pvector adapter module with pluggable vector store interface and query translation
Implement graceful fallback from vector search to canonical file-based context retrieval when no vector store available
Implement context memory retrieval benchmarks comparing vector vs file-based paths
Implement expertise routing signals extraction and confidence scoring from expertise model YAML
Implement governed expertise learning loop — proposal/review/promote lifecycle with CLI and validation
Implement expertise routing explainability surface — why agent X chosen for task Y, with signal breakdown
Implement WebUI backend hooks for run/session management — start, stop, inspect, resume endpoints
Implement WebUI backend hooks for tasks/mission tracking — list, status, filter, drill-down endpoints
Implement WebUI frontend console — run/session management UI (start, stop, inspect, resume)
Implement WebUI frontend console — tasks/mission tracking UI (list, status, filter, drill-down)
Integration tests: vector retrieval path with qmd/pvector adapter, fallback path, and boundary conditions
Integration tests: expertise routing confidence scoring, governed learning loop state transitions, explainability output
Integration tests: WebUI console workflows — run/session lifecycle, tasks/mission tracking, access control
Non-regression coverage: validate expertise-first routing preserved, bounded retrieval budgets enforced, runtime-agnostic contracts intact across all three pillars
Documentation: update operator docs, CLI help, and architecture diagrams for all three pillars
